title: 第十四章 这事跟我有啥关系？
slug: 傲世九重天全本免费-傲世九重天最新章节列表
content_zh:
现在的石千山，平素的雍容气度早已不知去向，眼睛里满是血丝，两个眼珠几乎鼓了出来。气急败坏之极。
“大师兄，此话从何说起？”楚阳从容的吐出一口气，结束了吐纳，一脸迷惘的道。
谈昙也随后进来，急忙劝道：“大师兄，二师兄也是不知道这些事……”
“放屁！”石千山气急败坏的大吼：“你怎么不说清楚？那人乃是李剑吟？你怎地……如此陷害我？”
石千山委屈的快哭了。这是造了哪门子孽啊？怎么稀里糊涂的就惹了这么一个大祸？这可真是躺着也中枪啊……
“我这可真是躺着也中枪啊……”楚阳表情无辜，极度冤枉地叫了起来：“大师兄，这件事跟我有什么关系？”
石千山一听这句话，鼻子顿时就气歪了，突然就眼前一黑，险些喷出血来。听着这个罪魁祸首居然在自己这个最大的受害者面前叫嚣什么‘这事跟我有什么关系’……实在是连心脏都在抽搐！
若不是你，我怎么会骂李剑吟？若不是你引起了李剑吟的仇恨，怎么会闹到这种地步？若不是你闹出这等事，我怎么会稀里糊涂的……陷入这等险恶处境？
现在，你这个罪魁祸首反而没事了，而我这个无辜者，反而成了人家的不共戴天之仇！
如今你居然很委屈地说‘这事跟我有什么关系’？你说跟你有什么关系？！
石千山咻咻的喘气，目瞪如铃，这些话堆满了肚子，硬是气的一句话也说不出来。
楚阳恶意的看着他的起伏剧烈的胸膛，心道若是一个女子这么起伏……倒也是很有看头的。可这丫愣是没有起伏出半点美感来……真是失败啊。
“是啊大师兄，这件事跟二师兄有啥关系？”谈昙挠了挠头，憨厚的道：“当时咱们都在场，二师兄也没说什么啊，倒是大师兄你义薄云天，挺身而出，为我们遮风挡雨，我们两人感激还来不及，怎么会害大师兄你啊……”
谈昙这些话全是心里话。对石千山的赞誉也是出自真心，他的确是对这位大师兄充满了好感。
但这些话听在石千山耳朵里，却成了无比辛辣的讽刺！
义薄云天？挺身而出？为你们遮风挡雨？这是多么滑稽的事情！你们算老几呀……
石千山身子晃了两晃，眼前一阵阵的发黑，张了张嘴，却说不出话来，一张脸涨成了猪肝色。只气的脑袋里嗡嗡作响，刹那间眼前金星乱冒。
重重的哼了一声，石千山黑着脸拂袖出门，只听见院子里传来猛地一声咳嗽，然后就是踉跄的声音响起，渐渐远去。
等到明天早晨，谈昙出门的时候才发现草丛里不知道是谁吐了一口血，腥气扑鼻……这件事，让可怜的谈昙纳闷了足足好几天……
额，谁吐的血？真奇怪……

楚阳看着石千山出去，眼神中尽是无尽冰雪。
石千山，恶毒，心机深沉；而且手腕也有，阴谋更多，就像一条毒蛇。这样的人，本应该早死早利索；但楚阳却不愿意让石千山早死！
一来，从石千山身上，楚阳可以学到很多自己不具备的东西。比如……阴险、毒辣、隐忍、心机、圆滑……
这些，都是前世的楚阳所不具备的！但不得不说，这些品质虽然说是下九流的，但在这个强者为尊的世界上，却是行走江湖所不能缺少的品质。
大丈夫立世，该毒辣的时候，就要毒辣！该耍手段的时候，也要耍手段。阴谋诡计，该用的时候，更要大用而特用！
因为，这一切都是为了保全自己。连自己都不能保全，那么，无论什么宏伟大志，都只是镜花水月而已。
历朝历代，传世人物均是有忠有奸，但有一点是肯定的：想要在青史上流芳百世，远远比遗臭万年要艰难得多！所以……那些能够留名青史的正面人物的心眼，恐怕要比那些反面人物要奸诈的多，心眼……也要多出几倍才可以！
二来，就是有些事情，楚阳现在还不方便直接出面。若是让门派中人发现自己的真实实力，那么，自己恐怕将麻烦无穷。尤其是那些虎视眈眈觊觎大师兄位置的人，一旦发现突然钻出来自己这么一个强有力的竞争者……自己岂不是就成了他们的靶子？

content_en:
Now Shi Qianshan's usual graceful demeanor has long since disappeared, his eyes are full of bloodshot eyes, and his two eyeballs are almost bulging. Extremely frustrated.
"Elder brother, where do you start talking about this?" Chu Yang calmly exhaled, finished speaking, and said with a confused look on his face.
Tan Tan also came in and hurriedly advised: "Senior Brother, Second Senior Brother also don't know these things..."
"Fart!" Shi Qianshan yelled angrily: "Why don't you tell me clearly? That person is Li Jianyin? How could you... frame me like this?"
Shi Qianshan was so aggrieved that he almost cried. What kind of evil has this been done? How could he cause such a big disaster in such a daze? This is really like being shot while lying down...
"I was really shot while I was lying down..." Chu Yang looked innocent and shouted with extreme injustice: "Senior Brother, what does this matter have to do with me?"
When Shi Qianshan heard this, his nose suddenly became angry, his vision suddenly went dark, and he almost spurted blood. Listening to the culprit actually shouting in front of himself, the biggest victim, "What does this have to do with me?"... Even my heart was twitching!
If it weren't for you, why would I scold Li Jianyin? If you hadn't aroused Li Jianyin's hatred, how could it have gotten to this point? If you hadn't caused such a thing, how could I have been so confused... and fallen into such a dangerous situation?
Now, you, the culprit, are fine, but I, the innocent person, have become their sworn enemy!
Now you actually feel aggrieved and say, 'What does this matter have to do with me?' What does it have to do with you? !
Shi Qianshan gasped for breath and stared as hard as a bell. His stomach was full of these words, and he was so angry that he couldn't say a word.
Chu Yang looked at his violent chest rising and falling maliciously, thinking that if a woman rose and fell like this... it would be quite interesting. But this girl didn't show any sense of beauty... What a failure.
"Yes, Senior Brother, what does this matter have to do with Second Senior Brother?" Tan Tan scratched his head and said honestly: "We were all present at the time, and Second Senior Brother didn't say anything. But Senior Brother, you are so kind and generous, and stepped forward to protect us from the wind and rain. It was too late for the two of us to be grateful. How could we harm Senior Brother..."
Tan Tan's words are all from his heart. His praise for Shi Qianshan came from the bottom of his heart. He was indeed very fond of this senior brother.
But to Shi Qianshan's ears, these words became extremely bitter irony!
Yi Bo Yuntian? Come forward? To protect you from wind and rain? What a funny thing! Who do you think you are...
Shi Qianshan swayed, his eyes turning black for a while, he opened his mouth, but could not speak, and his face turned the color of pig liver. His head was buzzing with anger, and stars suddenly appeared in front of his eyes.
With a heavy snort, Shi Qianshan fluttered his sleeves and went out with a dark face. He only heard a sudden cough from the yard, and then a staggering sound, which gradually faded away.
When Tan Tan went out tomorrow morning, he discovered that someone in the grass had spit out a mouthful of blood, and the fishy smell hit his nose... This incident made poor Tan Tan wonder for several days...
Um, who vomited blood? How strange...
Chu Yang watched Shi Qianshan go out, his eyes filled with endless ice and snow.
Shi Qianshan is vicious and scheming; he also has skills and more conspiracies, just like a poisonous snake. Such a person should have died early and quickly; but Chu Yang was unwilling to let Shi Qianshan die early!
First, Chu Yang could learn a lot of things from Shi Qianshan that he did not possess. For example... insidious, vicious, forbearing, scheming, tactful...
These are things that Chu Yang in his previous life did not possess! But it has to be said that although these qualities are considered low-class, in this world where the strong are respected, they are indispensable qualities for walking in the world.
When a man is born, he should be vicious when he should be vicious! When it's time to resort to tricks, but also resorting to tricks. Conspiracies and tricks should be used in a big and special way when they should be used!
Because, all this is to protect oneself. If you can't even protect yourself, then no matter what grand ambitions you have, they are just a mirror in the mirror.
Throughout the dynasties, there have been loyal and treacherous figures handed down from generation to generation, but one thing is certain: it is far more difficult to be famous in the history of history than to be infamy for thousands of years! Therefore...the minds of those positive figures who can leave a name in history are probably much more cunning than those of the villains, and their minds...must be several times more!
Secondly, there are some matters for which Chu Yang is not convenient to come forward directly. If someone in the sect discovers his true strength, then he may be in endless trouble. Especially those who are coveting the position of senior brother. Once they find out that such a strong competitor like themselves suddenly emerges... won't they become their target?
